integrity: The all-degree result is derived analytically by monotonic binomial-coefficient ratios; finite exact-rational checks are supplementary, with no independent mathematical audit.
scientific_limitations: Exact classification is limited to normalized one-variable fractional-power kernels multiplied by one sparse Szegő pullback; arbitrary Schur factors and a general concavity phase diagram are not addressed. Literature priority may involve older equivalent reciprocal-coefficient results.
title: Sharp complete-Pick threshold for a sparse Schur factor of a fractional Hardy kernel
